scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained once the exact affine chord formula is established. The most relevant later primary full text was materially and visually inspected. Exact-object, off-center, tangent-chord, support-line, conic, and broader-coverage searches were performed. The bundled computation is diagnostic only and does not substitute finite sampling for the polynomial identity.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to planar ellipses and does not settle the one-inner-disk problem for arbitrary smooth or strictly convex planar bodies.
No stability modulus under noisy chord data and no finite-direction reconstruction bound is claimed.
The original 2001 Barker--Larman article was not read in full during bounded lawful-access checks, leaving a residual historical-overlap risk.

title: Global planar Barker–Larman rigidity for arbitrary ellipses
